(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (deltas (list -30 -25 -20 -15 -10 -5 0 5 10 15 20 25 30))
                (positions (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                      (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                    (range 0 h))))
           (define (same-mod5? a b) (member? (- a b) deltas))
           (define (class-cells r c)
             (filter (lambda (p) (and (same-mod5? (fst p) r) (same-mod5? (snd p) c)))
                     positions))
           (define (regular? p)
             (let* ((v (at g (fst p) (snd p)))) (or (zero? v) (= v 8))))
           (define (clean-val r c)
             (let* ((regulars (filter regular? (class-cells r c)))
                    (c0 (count-if (lambda (p) (zero? (at g (fst p) (snd p)))) regulars))
                    (c8 (count-if (lambda (p) (= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 8)) regulars))
                    (first-reg (at g (fst (first regulars)) (snd (first regulars)))))
               (cond ((> c8 c0) 8) ((> c0 c8) 0) (else first-reg))))
           (let* ((clean (grid-from-fn h w clean-val))
                  (anoms (filter (lambda (p)
                                   (!= (third p) (clean-val (first p) (second p))))
                                 (grid-cells g))))
             (define (fill-color a)
               (if (and (!= (third a) 0) (!= (third a) 8)) (third a) 8))
             (define (fill-cells a)
               (let* ((ar (first a))
                      (ac (second a)))
                 (filter (lambda (p) (zero? (clean-val (fst p) (snd p))))
                         (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                    (map (lambda (c) (list r c))
                                         (range (+ ac 1) (min (+ ac 5) w))))
                                  (range (+ ar 1) (min (+ ar 5) h))))))
             (reduce (lambda (acc a) (paint-cells acc (fill-cells a) (fill-color a)))
                     clean
                     anoms)))))
